dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings on the dark pelt, showing a sharp gradient transition at the high-contrast perimeters. Most prominent are three interlocking circular structures on the lateral midsection and two distinct open loops dorsally.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the posterior-dorsal region and interspersed within the macro-annuli clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced area of high-specular reflectance on the anterior-lateral region, characterized by a cluster of saturated white pixels indicating a wet surface.
